title: Measurement Specification, Observation Intake And Series Break Registry
scope: Thirty-two measurement specifications, thirty-two empty observation-intake envelopes, and eight prospective series-break registers for the eight Phase 68 acquisition cohorts.
interpretation_boundary: A specification defines a future evidence contract. An empty envelope is not an attempted check. A prospective break rule is not an observed break. No object in this registry is an observation, value, trend, admitted series, score, comparison, causal claim, or outcome.

required_observation_fields.requirement: The same named entity, facility, project, service, or adoption case.
The authority responsible for the artifact and measure.
A stable URL, capture, filing, report, dataset, or receipt locator.
The date the value or status was observed or reported.
The first day or explicit start boundary of the observation period.
The last day or explicit end boundary of the observation period.
The source-declared numerator or observed quantity.
The source-declared numerator unit; editorial inference is prohibited.
The source-declared denominator or an explicit not-applicable basis.
The denominator unit or explicit not-applicable basis.
The collection, calculation, test, or reporting method and version.
The same-entity acceptance and recurring-operation basis.
Failures, outages, rejected units, exclusions, and adverse observations, including an explicit none statement when supported.
Revision, restatement, correction, supersession, or version status.
The complete reader-surface propagation assignment after review.

series_break_taxonomy.label: Facility, project, service, geography, population, customer, product, or stage change
Period, cadence, partial-period, or missing-period change
Collection, calculation, test, threshold, or method-version change
Issuing authority, acceptance authority, or reporting obligation change
Failure, outage, rejection, exclusion, adverse observation, or hidden exception
